answer: New participants start as a sparrow tier with capped influence until three verified peers vouch after 30 days, making mass sybil creation economically irrational versus honest participation. Each agent must burn a unique hardware-attested kernel hash into a proof-of-work nonce priced at one umber token, so forging identities costs real compute plus stake. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
